recap: Nifty 50 ended at 25,349.65 (-1.75%) and the Sensex at 82,443.96 (-1.76%); Bank Nifty moved -3.17%.
By size: large caps (Nifty 100) -1.67%, mid caps (Midcap 150) -0.91%, small caps (Smallcap 250) -0.72%.
IT led the sectors (+1.69%), while Metal lagged (-3.70%).
Top Nifty 500 gainer was ITI (+11.12%); biggest faller was APL Apollo Tubes (-21.29%). Breadth: 134 advances vs 364 declines.
Overseas, the S&P 500 last closed down 3.70% and the Nasdaq down 5.28%.
The rupee is at 92.91 per dollar, Brent at $89.59 (-3.22%) and gold at $3,614 (+2.81%).
